# Pull Request Template

## Description
Provide a brief description of the changes made in this pull request.

## Changes Made
- List the key changes implemented
- What features were added, modified, or removed
- Any refactoring or code improvements

## Testing
- Describe how the changes were tested
- Include any relevant test cases or scenarios
- Mention if manual testing was performed

## Screenshots (if applicable)
Attach screenshots, GIFs, or videos demonstrating the changes, especially for UI enhancements.

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows the project's coding standards and conventions
- [ ] All tests pass successfully
- [ ] Documentation has been updated (if applicable)
- [ ] No breaking changes introduced
- [ ] Code has been reviewed by at least one other developer

## Related Issues
Link to any related GitHub issues, user stories, or tickets (e.g., #123, #456)

## Additional Notes
Any additional information, context, or considerations for reviewers.
